== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ローグ砲手</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">乗客として宇宙船に乗っているなら、その宇宙船の兵器の武器運命数に1を加える。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">コルサント出身のケシン・オムニスに代表される砲手たちは、ビークルや宇宙船の後部砲塔の操作を担当する。高度な訓練によって兵器の扱いに精通している。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Rogue Gunner.

'''Lore''' — Gunners such as Kesin Ommis from Coruscant operate aft turrets on vehicles and starships. High training has made them skilled with weapons.

'''Game text''' — If aboard a starship as a passenger, add 1 to that starship's weapon destiny.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Game text adds その宇宙船の兵器の (that starship's weapon's) before weapon destiny. Lore says 後部砲塔の操作 rather than “posted to aft gunnery stations”.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-roguegunner-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rogue Gunner]].</ref>
